name: ultravein-protocol
description: Deploy a virtual VGA on Robinhood Chain, run it from your terminal, and mine ETH or tokenized stocks every hour.

scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:web && npm run rig:check
scripts.rig:check: node -e "const f=require('fs');if(!f.readFileSync('rig/rig.mjs').equals(f.readFileSync('web/public/rig.mjs'))){console.error('web/public/rig.mjs is out of date: npm run rig:sync');process.exit(1)}"
